original.description: A British soldier's kit laid out and itemised, photographed for the illustrated press. The Spaarnestad record, in Dutch, reads "The Great War. First World War: English soldiers kit, a survey of the clothing" and dates it 1915. The photographer is not named.
original.photographer: not established — the Spaarnestad record gives 'Unknown author'
original.date: 1915 (Spaarnestad record) — the year after the campaign this pack covers
original.archive: Spaarnestad Photo / Nationaal Archief (Netherlands), SFA022801761; via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; UsageTerms "Public domain"; AttributionRequired false).

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: leave as it is — the point of the picture is the inventory, and colour adds nothing an AI would not be guessing at.

content_policy: ok — clothing and equipment laid out for the camera; no casualties
caption: A British soldier's kit laid out and counted, photographed for the press in 1915 — the marching load itemised: pack, haversack, entrenching tool, mess tin, water bottle, ammunition pouches, greatcoat.
credit: Original photograph: photographer not established, 1915; Spaarnestad Photo / Nationaal Archief, SFA022801761, via Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. Dated 1915 by the archive, not 1914: the caption says the year and the card treats it as the pattern of load rather than as a photograph of the BEF in August 1914. CAUTION for the image review (sand-y0u.7): the individual items were not identified from the image, which was not viewed — either confirm the list in the caption against the frame or shorten it.
